system.description:
ARCHIVIST CHANCE UTILITY WARDING
Archivist Specialist Spell
Cast R (verbal)
Trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet fails, but does not fumble or blunder, a saving throw
Range 30 feet
Targets the triggering creature

You invoke a recorded miracle at the moment disaster appears inevitable.
The target rerolls the triggering saving throw and must use the new result.
After benefiting from Saintly Intercession, the creature becomes temporarily immune to the spell for 10 minutes.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: May also be used if the saving throw was a fumble.
+4 PP: May also be used if the saving throw was a blunder.
+4 PP: The target gains a +2-status bonus to the rerolled saving throw.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. Offered the moment an ally within range fails a save: cast it as the reaction and the save is rerolled; the ally is then immune for 10 minutes.
